summary: PathForge AI iteration 4 — full backend + frontend test pass. Added TestSimulator (2 tests) and TestWeeklyReview (4 tests) to /app/backend/tests/test_pathforge.py. Backend: 61/62 PASSED in 319s. All new endpoints work: POST /api/ai/simulator returns simulation.routes with 3 routes each having name/tagline/steps/skills/effort/duration/milestones/risks/alternatives + caveats; GET /api/ai/simulator/history persists >=1 item; POST /api/ai/weekly-review returns review_id + review with summary/wins/missed/risks/adjustments/next_week_focus/roadmap_changes; GET /api/ai/weekly-review/latest returns the newly created review; POST /api/ai/weekly-review/accept applies only roadmap_changes whose node_id matches a real node and returns {applied:int, roadmap}, and applied statuses persist in GET /api/roadmap; invalid review_id returns 404. The single failure (TestAIRepeated::test_generate_roadmap_four_times) is a pre-existing LLM stochastic shape-drift on the 2nd of 4 consecutive roadmap calls returning 502 'AI returned invalid JSON shape' — same class of flaky failure noted in prior iterations, not caused by iteration 4. Frontend: all iteration-4 flows pass end-to-end using public preview URL. Simulator page navigation, sim-run + 3 route cards visible (route text 1961/2141/2389 chars). Weekly Review page: rev-summary/wins/missed/risks/next all rendered; rev-changes appeared; rev-accept clicked and label toggled to APPLIED; rev-customize present. Wake-toggle exists in sidebar and its class changes on click (visual active state works). Forge drawer opens, voice-toggle works, chat message sent without console/page errors; forge-live-transcript correctly absent in headless (speechSynthesis unavailable — degrades gracefully). Regression: dashboard, roadmap, skills, academics, projects, hobbies, careers, skill-gap all render with 0 page errors.

minor.issue: Flaky LLM shape-drift on repeated back-to-back calls (1/4 runs returned 502 'AI returned invalid JSON shape'). Same intermittent behavior seen across iterations; require_keys + retry catches most cases but not 100%. Consider bumping retry count from 1 to 2 for this endpoint.

action_items: OPTIONAL: consider raising llm_json retry from 1 to 2 (or lowering temperature) for generate-roadmap to close the last ~5% flaky shape-drift window.
critical_code_review_comments: React Flow warning on /roadmap: 'You've created a new nodeTypes or edgeTypes object' — memoize nodeTypes/edgeTypes with useMemo or define outside component (perf + prevents needless re-renders).
server.py now 808 lines — approaching 800-line split threshold flagged last iteration. Recommend extracting Simulator + WeeklyReview + AI endpoints into a routers/ai.py module.
Class-scoped fixture defined as instance method deprecation warning in TestAIGeneration._seed still present (breaks in pytest 10).

weekly_review_accept allows 'completed' in its allowed set even though the LLM system prompt restricts new_status to available/recommended/in_progress/locked — either tighten the accept-side allowlist to match the prompt, or update the prompt to allow 'completed'. Current mismatch is silent but could surprise students.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 features (Simulator, WeeklyReview, Wake toggle, ForgeDrawer live-transcript element) are backend + frontend verified on the public preview URL. AI endpoints take 20-90s each — keep AI_TIMEOUT >=120s. Backend tests use localhost:8001 for AI calls (edge stable this run, but localhost is safer for long-running LLM). The 1/4 roadmap flake is stochastic LLM behavior not iteration-4 code. speechSynthesis + wake-word audio are NOT testable headless — do not fail the run if forge-live-transcript is absent.
rca of the issue: Only unresolved item is the stochastic LLM shape-drift on repeated roadmap regen (approx 5-10% failure rate). Existing mitigation (require_keys + 1 retry with stricter prompt + json-repair) closes most cases. Bumping retry to 2 or lowering temperature would likely eliminate remainder. Not an iteration-4 regression.
